cases._why: The number the whole design is pinned to. A full bottle must not read 16 of 17.
The second pinned number. Only a 1.5 oz pour rounded to nearest gives both 17 and 16.
Four pours from a 750: the acceptance case. The denominator stays capacity.
30 ml left rounds up to one pour, so it is not reported as empty.
10 ml left rounds to no pours but is not empty: the UI says 'less than a pour'.
Over-pouring past empty is a logging mistake, not a bottle that owes you whiskey.
Every other standard of fill, so a size change cannot pass unnoticed.
A reading above the bottle's capacity is clamped; a fill bar at 120% is visibly wrong.
Pours count down from the reading, not from full.
A negative reading is clamped to empty rather than going through zero.
